audience: salon owners and managers who run bookings, staff and sales in Bokadirekt

useCases.title: Check the bookings for a day and the staff for each
useCases.text: List the locations, then list the bookings in a date range with their staff member, service and time. Date ranges can span at most 365 days.

useCases.title: Review sales and payments per location
useCases.text: List the sales receipts for a date range, with their rows and payments. Each receipt refers to a location from the locations list.

useCases.title: Count customers who gave SMS consent, by city
useCases.text: List the customers with their consent flags and city. The national ID is never returned, and the tools do not send messages.

useCases.title: List services, add-ons and companies
useCases.text: List the bookable services with their add-on flags. List the companies that issue receipts, with their organisation numbers.

useCases.title: Check retail product stock per location
useCases.text: List the retail products with supplier, barcode and stock per location. The tools do not change stock.
